anima.config.option.brain.stickiness.des: Bonus added to whatever the Person is already doing, so small swings in pressure don't leave them dithering between two urges.
anima.config.option.brain.preempt.desc: How much raw pressure a new urge needs before it may cut into a task already under way.
anima.config.option.instincts.flee_range: Distance in blocks at which a threat starts to register at all.
Distance in blocks over which fear ramps from nothing to full panic.
anima.config.option.instincts.descend_pr: Urge to climb down off a leftover pillar. Keep it below the interrupt threshold so a legitimate mid-climb chop is never cut short.
anima.config.option.instincts.wander_idl: The do-something floor: every real drive must beat this. At 0 an unbothered Person simply stands still.
anima.config.option.instincts.wander_rad: How far, in blocks, an idle saunter may pick its next stop.
anima.config.option.instincts.flee_range: Multiplies the notice range for a threat holding a bow, crossbow or trident — arrows out-reach claws, so fear starts farther out.
anima.config.option.instincts.flee_appro: Extra fear when a threat is measurably closing in — the observable stand-in for "it is hunting me".
anima.config.option.perception.sense_rad: Horizontal sensing radius in blocks. Cost grows with its square — a walking Person sweeps about 2R columns per block moved.
anima.config.option.perception.reads_per: How many blocks one Person may read each tick. The main performance dial.
anima.config.option.perception.queue_cap: How many spotted-but-unexamined columns may back up before new sightings are dropped.
anima.config.option.perception.region_ma: Block budget for scanning one structure; hitting it leaves the region marked as only partly known.
How far a scan may spread from where it began — what splits one fused mega-forest into separate groves.
anima.config.option.perception.knowledge: How many places of each kind a Person remembers before the stalest is forgotten. Must exceed the trees they work among, or edge trees are forgotten and rediscovered forever.
anima.config.option.peers.radius.desc: How far away, in blocks, another being can be perceived at all.
anima.config.option.peers.sneak_range_mu: Shrinks the range at which a sneaking being is noticed. Sneaking shortens how far away you are spotted; it never makes you invisible.
anima.config.option.peers.cone_degrees.d: Horizontal field of view in degrees. Beings outside it go unseen until they make noise; 360 sees in every direction.
anima.config.option.peers.vertical_degre: Half-angle in degrees above and below where the Person is looking — human sight is wide but flat. 90 removes the up/down limit.
anima.config.option.peers.hearing_radius: How far away, in blocks, noise-makers are noticed regardless of the view cone. Sneaking beings are silent; 0 makes a Person deaf.
anima.config.option.peers.linger_ticks.d: Object permanence: how long a being stays perceived — frozen as last remembered — after both sight and sound have gone quiet.
anima.config.option.peers.heard_activity: How long an activity known only by sound — heard mining, a heard scuffle — stays believed after the noise stops. Afterwards only the bare presence is left.
anima.config.option.peers.near_interval_: How often, in ticks, a being standing right there is re-checked.
anima.config.option.peers.far_interval_t: How often, in ticks, a being at the edge of range is re-checked. Distances in between fall between the two.
anima.config.option.peers.herd_link_radi: How far apart two animals of the same species may stand and still count as one herd. Herds link in chains, so a spread-out pasture still joins up.
anima.config.option.peers.ray_budget.des: Base line-of-sight checks per Person per tick. The real budget grows with the backlog, so a large wave of mobs is noticed within a few ticks — checks are deferred, never skipped.
anima.config.option.danger.melee_mult.de: Danger multiplier for a visibly held melee weapon — a zombie with a sword outranks bare claws.
anima.config.option.danger.ranged_mult.d: Danger multiplier for a visibly held ranged weapon: bow, crossbow or trident.
Danger multiplier for visible armor on the body.
Danger multiplier for a mounted body, such as a skeleton riding a spider or a horse.
anima.config.option.danger.baby_mult.des: Danger multiplier for a baby variant — smaller, faster and harder to hit.
anima.config.option.social.hail_radius.d: How far away, in blocks, a shouted hail is heard. A hail has to carry further than sight or it would add nothing to simply noticing someone. This also sizes a Person's ear; quieter sounds are still limited to the hearing range.
anima.config.option.claims.ttl_ticks.des: How long a claimed work site outlives its last heartbeat before another Person may take the spot. 20 ticks is one second.
anima.config.option.journal.max_entries_: How many journal entries each Person keeps. Older ones are dropped once it fills.
anima.config.option.journal.max_age_tick: How old a journal entry may get before it is dropped. The default is 10 minutes of game time.
anima.config.option.journal.sweep_interv: How often the journal clears out entries that have aged past their lifetime.
anima.config.option.journal.file_sink.de: Also mirror each Person's journal to logs/autarkia/<person>.log on disk.
